# Scroll Component — Complete Reference

## Overview

The scroll component is a scrollable view container supporting both vertical and horizontal directions. "竖向滚动需要设置定高，水平滚动需要设置定宽" (vertical scrolling requires a fixed height; horizontal scrolling requires a fixed width).

It accepts child components, including nested scroll elements.

---

## Attributes (Properties)

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `scroll-x` | boolean | false | Enables horizontal scrolling |
| `scroll-y` | boolean | false | Enables vertical scrolling |
| `scroll-top` | number/string | — | Sets vertical scroll position (distance from content top to scroll top); snapping applies after scroll |
| `scroll-bottom` | number/string | — | Sets vertical position via distance from content bottom to scroll bottom; `scroll-top` takes precedence if both set |
| `scroll-left` | number/string | — | Sets horizontal scroll position (content left to scroll left) |
| `scroll-right` | number/string | — | Sets horizontal position via distance from content right; `scroll-left` takes precedence if both set |
| `bounces` | boolean | false | Enables boundary bounce-back effect |

All attributes support **general properties** from the framework.

---

## Styles

All **general styles** are supported, plus these specialized snap styles:

| Name | Values | Default | Description |
|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `scroll-snap-type` | `x` or `y` + `mandatory`/`proximity`/`cross` | proximity | Defines the snap behavior on the scroll container itself. `mandatory` snaps to the nearest anchor; `proximity` snaps only within 30% of container height; `cross` snaps when an anchor enters the viewport. |
| `scroll-snap-align` | none / start / center / end / edge | none | Applied to child elements; controls how they align with the scroll viewport during snapping. `edge` aligns to start or end boundary depending on scroll direction. |
| `scroll-snap-stop` | normal / always | normal | When set to `always`, snapping cannot skip over intermediate elements. |

---

## How Scrolling Works

Scrolling is enabled by setting `scroll-x="true"` or `scroll-y="true"`. The scroll container must have a **fixed dimension** perpendicular to the scroll axis (fixed height for vertical, fixed width for horizontal). Content exceeding the container becomes scrollable.

Programmatic scrolling is available via:

- **`scrollTo({ left, top, behavior })`** — Jumps to an absolute coordinate. `behavior` can be `smooth`, `instant`, or `auto` (equivalent to instant). Negative values clamp to 0; values beyond content size clamp to the scroll boundary.
- **`scrollBy({ left, top, behavior })`** — Scrolls by a relative offset. Accepts negative values for reverse direction.

Both methods are asynchronous and support a `success` callback returning `{ width, height }` of the scrollable content.

The method **`getScrollRect()`** retrieves the scrollable content's dimensions (width and height, including border and padding).

---

## Events

| Name | Parameters | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| `scrolltop` | — | Fires when the user scrolls to the top boundary |
| `scrollbottom` | — | Fires when the user scrolls to the bottom boundary |
| `scroll` | `{ scrollX, scrollY }` | Fires during any scroll action; provides horizontal and vertical scroll distances |

---

## Summary

The scroll component provides a flexible container with directional scrolling, boundary bouncing, snap alignment with three strategies (`mandatory`, `proximity`, `cross`), event callbacks for position tracking, and programmatic scroll control through `scrollTo` and `scrollBy` methods with configurable smooth/instant behavior.

  6月24日，救援人员在委内瑞拉首都加拉加斯的一处建筑废墟工作。新华社发（马科斯·萨尔加多摄）

  1900年10月29日，首都加拉加斯所处的北部米兰达州附近海域发生7.7级地震，造成至少140人死亡。这是委内瑞拉有记录以来震级最大的地震。
